1.4.6.en: Added a custom icon for the hybrid Fault/Alarm Detail capability, shown at pairing and restored automatically if the capability is added to an existing device. Fixed the icon not rendering — it now declares a proper default icon instead of relying only on a per-device override. EXPERIMENTAL, not yet validated against a real device: extended Fault/Alarm Detail decoding to string inverters (deye_string), based on Deye's official Modbus protocol doc confirming the same register layout as hybrid models — added automatically to existing paired string devices, no re-pairing needed. Corrected two previously-guessed fault names and added several new ones from that same official source. Added three new flow cards: "Fault/alarm detected" trigger, "Fault/alarm is active" condition, and "Fault is ..." condition (with a device-aware suggestion list — battery-specific faults are hidden for string/micro inverters). Report back if any of this doesn't match what you see on your actual inverter.

1.4.5.en: Improved crash resilience in polling and the dashboard widget so a single bad reading no longer skips the rest of an update. Reduced routine log verbosity so diagnostic reports capture more useful history leading up to an issue instead of repeated status lines. Fixed the offline warning getting stuck through the night after a temporary connection issue at dusk. Fixed the per-device pairing icon (inverter/battery/grid meter) not applying, so all three showed the same icon. Added two device settings, "Show PV string voltage/current detail" and "Show AC connection voltage/current detail", to hide the per-string and L1 Voltage/Current tiles if you only need the power readings — on by default, no re-pairing needed to change. Fixed those same detail tiles showing a generic label (e.g. "Voltage") instead of their specific one (e.g. "PV1 Voltage") when re-enabled. Added a Fault/Alarm Detail capability on hybrid inverters (deye_hybrid / deye_sg04lp3) that decodes the raw fault/alarm registers into readable text instead of just an on/off alarm flag. Fixed the PV/AC detail toggle reacting to the previous setting value instead of the new one, causing it to do the opposite of what was just changed until the app restarted. Fixed startup unconditionally re-adding PV1/PV2 Voltage/Current on every init, overriding the PV detail setting if it had been turned off.

1.4.4.en: Fixed night-time detection for locations west of UTC (e.g. UTC-6) where the sunset returned by astral falls on the next calendar day in UTC. The old logic inverted day and night, causing string/micro inverters to stay in night backoff during local daytime and show zero values.

1.4.3.en: Added multilingual titles for dynamically detected capabilities; newly paired devices now follow Homey's language changes. Renamed the two battery power readings to "Power Usage" and "Power Delivery" to avoid duplicate labels, without changing values, signs, or Homey Energy behavior. Offline timeline notifications are now disabled by default for newly paired devices. Re-pairing is required to apply translated capability titles to existing devices.

1.3.5.en: Fixed hybrid inverter Energy Dashboard: Solar Generated now correctly shows PV-only production instead of AC output (which includes battery discharge). Removed a duplicate register (reg 63-64) that was overwriting Total Production with total AC output. Re-pairing required for existing hybrid inverter devices to apply the correct Energy Dashboard settings.

1.3.4.en: Fixed hybrid inverter (deye_hybrid): removed PV3/PV4 register entries that conflicted with Battery Status (register 189), causing Battery Status to always show Charging. Fixed AC Output Power showing the same value as Solar Power — AC output now correctly reflects inverter AC production instead of PV DC input. Fixed the same AC output override on string inverters. Request blocks split for better Modbus compatibility.

1.3.2.en: Fixed Energy Dashboard for hybrid inverters: Grid Meter now exposes live grid power (W) via measurePowerConsumedCapability so Homey Energy correctly shows grid consumption. Existing Grid Meter devices are upgraded automatically without re-pairing. Inverter caps initialised to 0 on startup to prevent null values on the Energy Dashboard.

1.2.13.en: Added Battery Temperature and Battery Status (Charging/Discharging/Standby) capabilities to the battery device. Fixed flow condition 'Is battery charging?' — was firing inverted due to raw Deye signal polarity. String/micro inverters no longer show a warning triangle at night — device tile stays clean with 0W and today's production total. Pairing now includes cumulative energy capabilities (grid import/export, battery charged/discharged) even when their value is 0 at pairing time. App renamed to Deye Inverter (Local).

1.0.1.en: Node.js version. Manual IP and serial entry. Supports single-phase string inverters (2 and 4 MPPT).

1.2.0.en: Complete rewrite in Python using the Homey Pro Python runtime. Automatic UDP discovery — no IP or serial needed. Auto-detects inverter model by probing registers. Dynamic capabilities — only sensors with real data are shown. Supports 4 models: string (2/4 MPPT), microinverter, hybrid, and SG04LP3 3-phase hybrid. Night backoff using local sunrise/sunset. Tested on Deye SUN-9K-G03 with LSW3 logger.

1.2.2.en: Fixed TCP polling on Homey Pro — replaced pysolarmanv5 with a built-in SolarmanV5 transport that avoids multiprocessing semaphores blocked by the Homey sandbox. Added Wi-Fi SSID and signal strength to device settings. Improved unavailability detection during daytime failures.

1.2.3.en: Localized pairing UI in 10 languages (EN, NL, DE, FR, IT, SV, NO, ES, DA, PL). Pair screens now use Homey i18n.

1.2.4.en: Added full UI localization for pairing views

1.2.5.en: Fixed settings not being applied — polling interval and connection settings now update correctly.

1.2.6.en: Rebuilt Python packages with latest runtime for improved compatibility.

1.2.7.en: Fixed Energy Dashboard for hybrid inverters: battery now visible in the energy overview, and solar production correctly shows PV input power (PV1+PV2) instead of AC output (which includes battery discharge).

1.2.8.en: Two-device architecture for hybrid inverters: inverter and battery now appear as separate devices in Homey, enabling proper Energy Dashboard integration (battery SOC, charge/discharge energy). Battery device keeps polling through the night while the inverter goes offline. Added flow cards: triggers for solar production started/stopped, grid lost/restored, and data updated (with power, daily production, battery SOC and grid power tokens). Conditions: is solar producing, is battery charging, is feeding to grid. Re-pairing required for all existing devices.

1.2.9.en: Restored pysolarmanv5 library with a sandbox compatibility patch (fixes multiprocessing semaphore error on Homey Pro). Fixed hybrid inverter night backoff — hybrid stays online 24/7 via battery and no longer shows zeroed values at night. Fixed string/micro inverters being incorrectly marked as unavailable when the logger loses power at night (expected behaviour). Re-pairing required for hybrid inverters to apply the night fix.

1.2.10.en: Reverted to built-in V5 transport — pysolarmanv5 caused app crashes on Homey Pro (background task exception in Python 3.14). All fixes from 1.2.9 are preserved: hybrid night backoff, string/micro night handling, and is_hybrid flag. Re-pairing required for hybrid inverters.

1.2.11.en: Stability fix: reverted to built-in SolarmanV5 transport to prevent app crashes on Homey Pro. Hybrid inverters no longer show zeroed values at night. String/micro inverters no longer marked as unavailable when the logger loses power after sunset. Re-pairing required for hybrid inverters.

1.2.12.en: Fixed zombie device callbacks causing app crashes (SharedPoller unsubscribe used identity check instead of equality). Fixed set_unavailable being called on every failed poll instead of once on transition. Fixed wrong logger serial used when detaching poller after settings change. Hybrid inverters now detected by model name — no re-pairing required. Added set_warning for night offline on string/micro inverters. Added Battery Status and Battery Temperature capabilities.

1.2.14.en: Added Battery Temperature and Battery Status (Charging/Discharging/Standby) capabilities to the battery device. Fixed flow condition "Is battery charging?" — was firing inverted due to raw Deye signal polarity. String/micro inverters no longer show a warning triangle at night — device tile stays clean with 0W and today's production total. Pairing now includes cumulative energy capabilities (grid import/export, battery charged/discharged) even when their value is 0 at pairing time. App renamed to Deye Inverter (Local).

1.3.1.en: Fixed Grid Meter device appearing for string and micro inverters — Grid Meter is now created only for hybrid models (deye_hybrid and deye_sg04lp3). String and micro inverters show grid power directly on the main inverter tile, restoring the clean 1.2.x behaviour. Added inverter icon to inverter and Grid Meter device tiles. Re-pairing required: please remove and re-add your devices to apply the new device layout.

1.3.0.en: dded Grid Meter as a third device (class: sensor) for hybrid and string inverters. Tracks cumulative grid import and grid export energy, enabling the Homey Energy Dashboard to display how much energy you buy from and sell to the grid — without needing a separate Shelly or P1 meter. Re-pairing required to add the Grid Meter device

1.3.3.en: Fixed night backoff incorrectly triggering when Homey timezone is unavailable — inverter no longer shows 0W/0V during the day for users in timezones where clock.get_timezone() returns None (e.g. Brazil UTC-3). Night detection now safely disabled if geolocation or timezone data is missing.

1.3.6.en: Fixed hybrid energy mapping so Homey Energy now uses real PV lifetime production instead of Total Grid Production, preventing battery discharge from being counted as solar generation.

1.3.7.en: Fixed Homey Energy configuration for dynamically paired Deye devices. Hybrid inverters now explicitly sync their Energy settings on startup so the dashboard uses solar PV production instead of AC/load power. Battery and Grid devices also re-apply their specific Energy roles reliably.

1.3.8.en: Energy Dashboard now correctly shows solar production instead of AC output power — existing hybrid devices are repaired automatically on next restart, no re-pairing required. Battery discharge energy tracking fixed (devices paired with earlier versions recover automatically). Auto-discovery (UDP) improved for loggers that only respond on port 48899. Missing pairing screen translations added for DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, NO, PL, SV, DA.

1.3.9.en: Inverter device is now registered as class solarpanel — Solar production now appears correctly in the Homey Energy Dashboard. Devices paired with earlier versions are migrated automatically on restart, no re-pairing required. Improved Modbus compatibility: partial register responses accepted and large register blocks split to respect inverter limits.

1.4.0.en: Fixed TCP socket leak that caused 15-20 min polling blackouts when a poll was interrupted (CancelledError now always closes the socket). String/micro inverters no longer go unavailable at night — warning triangle shows during daytime outages, unavailable state reserved for persistent failures (~2 h). Timeline notification when logger is unreachable for a configurable number of minutes (default 10, set 0 to disable). Sunrise/sunset coordinates auto-filled from Homey geolocation. Wi-Fi signal display fixed (logger reports percentage, not dBm).

1.4.1.en: Fixed: app crash when saving geolocation coordinates to device settings. Fixed: Solar production started trigger firing on every app restart. Fixed: Daily data updated trigger missing from flow card list. Fixed: night backoff activating at wrong hours when Homey location is not configured.
